resources.string: Connection refused: turn on wireless debugging, or run adb tcpip 5555 again from the PC.
Not authorized: accept the “Allow debugging” prompt in the headset, then try again.
Pairing required: pair the app with a code.
Code rejected or expired: request a new code and try again.
Wireless debugging not found: turn it back on in the developer options. No need to pair again.
Unexpected failure: try again. If it persists, turn wireless debugging off and on again.
Open the developer options and turn on “Wireless debugging”.
Tap “Pair device with pairing code”, keep that panel next to this one, then enter the port and code below.
Couldn\'t open them automatically: go through the headset settings (Settings → System → Developer) or the Android developer options.
Leave empty to find it automatically.

Unplug the cable, tap “Connect (via PC)”, then accept the debugging prompt in the headset (“Always allow”).
To be done again after each headset restart.
